ToolPort — concept for MCP-compatible tool providers.

Covers both MCP servers and Deno/Clawhub skills — all treated identically as JSON-RPC processes. One ToolPort, one McpClientAdapter.

Adapters: McpClientAdapter (subprocess JSON-RPC via stdin/stdout).

../core/pipeops
